transcript: There is water in the whole street, we cannot come out, my mother is old and cannot walk.
We are four people on the roof, the water reached the first floor, there is a small child with us.
The hill came down behind our house, mud everywhere, one man is trapped under it.
My father is not breathing properly, he needs a hospital, the road ahead is under water.
Some water is coming into the compound but we are fine, just informing.
Water everywhere, near the temple, please send someone quickly.
The wall of our house has cracked and it is leaning, three of us inside, we are afraid to move.
Road is blocked with fallen trees, no vehicle can pass, no one is hurt.
വെള്ളം കയറുന്നു, ഞങ്ങൾ കുടുങ്ങി, ഒരു കുട്ടിയുണ്ട്.
पानी बढ़ रहा है, हम छत पर हैं, मदद भेजिए।
My wife is pregnant and the labour pains have started, we are cut off by the flood water.
A boy went into the current near the culvert and has not come up, please hurry.
My grandmother uses a wheelchair and the water is at the doorstep, we cannot carry her down alone.
Gas cylinder caught fire in the kitchen, smoke is filling the house, we are still inside.
There is a bad cut on my leg from broken glass, bleeding will not stop, water is rising too.
நீர் வீட்டுக்குள் வருகிறது, என் தந்தை நடக்க முடியாதவர், உதவி தேவை.
వరద నీరు లోపలికి వస్తోంది, పసిపిల్లవాడు ఉన్నాడు, సహాయం కావాలి.
ನೀರು ಮನೆಯೊಳಗೆ ಬರುತ್ತಿದೆ, ನಾವು ಸಿಕ್ಕಿಬಿದ್ದಿದ್ದೇವೆ, ಬೇಗ ಬನ್ನಿ.
Just checking, we heard the siren, but our street is completely dry so far.
Small leak near the compound wall, nothing serious, no need to send anyone yet.
The bridge near our lane is under water, we are safe at home, just letting you know it is impassable.
My neighbour who is blind is alone next door and the lane is flooding, someone should check on him.
Two of us are stuck on a rooftop, the water is still climbing, we do not know how long the roof will hold.
Electric wire fell into the standing water outside, sparking, please warn people and send help.
My son has a high fever and the clinic road is flooded, we need him seen urgently.
Water has entered the ground floor overnight, we moved everything upstairs, we are okay for now.
मेरी बुज़ुर्ग माँ को साँस लेने में तकलीफ़ है और घर के बाहर पानी भर गया है।
ഞങ്ങളുടെ വീടിന്റെ മേൽക്കൂര ഇളകി വീഴാൻ പോകുന്നു, അകത്ത് അഞ്ചു പേരുണ്ട്.
